text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon showed an amazing 
performance!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon delivered a solid 
performance. It was a run that raised high 
hopes for her future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Narita Brian remained out of 
form, and the public's expectations were 
waning. Hishi Amazon believed the only 
thing she could do was wait for her at the 
pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In an interview before the Japan Cup, 
Hishi Amazon states clearly that her rival 
remains Narita Brian, just as before—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon believed in Narita Brian's 
comeback. Her words seemed to sway the 
public's impression of Brian as well...!
